subject: Scheduling: Dedicated capacity sizing call (throughput & latency requirements)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintechco.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up + next steps: dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Alex / Sonia —

Thanks again for the discovery today — really helpful to understand FinTechCo's production patterns and priorities. Quick recap of what I heard so we can make the technical call as productive as possible:

- Primary workload: real-time fraud scoring for payment flows
- Peak throughput estimate: ~200 requests/sec (spiky around payroll/run times)
- Average request size: ~120 tokens in / ~60 tokens out
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 150ms for classification path
- Required throughput headroom: 2x buffer for peak bursts
- Security: SOC2 required; data residency in US; no PHI

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with your infra/ML engineer(s) and our serving/runtime team to map these into a Dedicated configuration (instances, batch/kv-cache strategy, autoscale policy). Proposed agenda:

1) Quick alignment on traffic patterns and SLOs (10m)
2) Walk through FinTechCo workload examples and token distributions (15m)
3) Capacity modeling and candidate Dedicated configs (20m)
4) Open questions / next steps (15m)

Availability — can you do one of these slots?
- Wed Aug 4: 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Thu Aug 5: 11:00–11:45 AM PT
- Fri Aug 6: 1:00–1:45 PM PT

Please confirm attendees (we recommend your infra lead + ML lead) and attach any sample workload exports (CSV) ahead of the call so our team can pre-run a sizing model. I’m attaching a small CSV template you can fill (FinTechCo_product_workloads.csv) and a capacity_sizing_template.xlsx — feel free to drop a link if files are large.

Thanks — looping in David Kim (our infra lead) to join the call.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0123

Attachments: FinTechCo_product_workloads.csv, capacity_sizing_template.xlsx

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the templates. Wed Aug 4 at 10:00 AM PT works for us. I'll bring our infra lead (Sonia Patel) and our ML engineering manager (Rajiv Menon).

A few quick answers to your sizing questions (so you have them ahead of the call):
- Peak requests/sec: ~200 sustained for short windows (peak bursts up to ~350 for ~2–5 minutes)
- Expected concurrency (avg): ~150
- Average prompt tokens: 120 in; response tokens ~60
- Typical session length: stateless single-call scoring (no KV cache per user currently)
- QPS distribution: majority between 9am–10am PT and 1pm–2pm PT with occasional evening bursts

I attached the CSV export from our staging harness (FinTechCo_product_workloads.csv). Let us know if you want more detailed traffic traces or a sample request/response.

See you Wed — Alex

Quick note from infra/serving side:

Alex — could you confirm whether the 200 req/sec peak is dominated by many short requests (sub-50 token prompts) or by fewer, larger requests (100+ tokens) — that influences batching strategy and GPU memory planning. Also: do you currently have any KV cache usage per session (session affinity) or is each call independent?

If you can paste a short exemplar of request-size distribution (percentiles) that'd be great. We'll use that to prepare 2 candidate Dedicated configs for Aug 4.

Thanks — David
